subject: Your 28-day report is ready
preview_text: See what you've actually accomplished in your first month of healing. It might surprise you.
body_paragraphs: Day 28. That's four weeks of showing up for yourself when everything inside you wanted to collapse. You've opened this app on good days, bad days, and the days where 3AM felt like it would never end. Here's what the numbers say: you've tracked 28 days of emotions, completed 14 guided exercises, and your no-contact streak hit 12 days last week — even after that moment you almost texted them.

Healing isn't linear, but progress is real. Our data shows that users who make it to this point see a 40% faster reduction in obsessive thoughts. You're not just surviving the breakup — you're rewiring how your brain processes loss. That spiral you had on Tuesday? The app logged it. And you bounced back in half the time it took you in week one.

This is where the AI therapist becomes your secret weapon. You've already used it during an emergency mode session — that was smart. Now unlock the 'Healing Milestones' feature in your dashboard. It maps your mood trends against your no-contact streak and coping exercise completions. One look at that graph and you'll see exactly how far you've come.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy now and tap 'Your Journey' to see your personalized milestone summary. It'll show you the specific moment your recovery curve shifted. P.S. Most users who reach Day 28 report their first genuine 'good day' in the next 48 hours. That could be today.
